categories.descrizione: Archetipo Composizionale: Nested-Complex Triple (JOIN + Subquery + Set Operation): Combinare simultaneamente un JOIN, una subquery annidata e un operatore insiemistico (UNION / INTERSECT / EXCEPT) applicato sopra i risultati di subquery. Zero-Data: il modello deve inventare uno schema con chiavi esterne implicite e molte tabelle di distrazione.
categories.vincoli: Zero-Data: il modello deve inventare uno schema con chiavi esterne implicite e molte tabelle di distrazione, e risolvere una query che unisce tabelle con JOIN, filtra con una subquery nella clausola WHERE, e fonde i risultati con un operatore insiemistico (UNION/INTERSECT/EXCEPT).
categories.instructions: Generare un database e una storia di business realistica che costringa l'LLM a comporre tutte queste feature contemporaneamente per risolvere la richiesta dell'utente nel contesto 'Zero-Data'.
esempi_sql:
SELECT e.name
FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON e.dept_id = d.id
WHERE d.location = 'HQ'
  AND e.salary > (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM employees)
EXCEPT
SELECT c.name
FROM contractors c
WHERE c.clearance = 'standard';

esempi_sql:
WITH regional_sales AS (
  SELECT r.region_id, SUM(o.amount) AS total
  FROM orders o
  JOIN regions r ON o.region_id = r.id
  GROUP BY r.region_id
),
top_regions AS (
  SELECT region_id, total
  FROM regional_sales
  ORDER BY total DESC
  LIMIT 3
)
SELECT c.category_name, SUM(o.amount) AS category_revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN top_regions tr ON o.region_id = tr.region_id
JOIN categories c ON o.category_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.category_name;

esempi_sql:
SELECT d.department_name,
       e.full_name,
       e.salary,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.department_name ORDER BY e.salary DESC) AS salary_rank
FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON e.dept_id = d.id
WHERE e.employment_status = 'active'
  AND d.annual_budget > 100000;

SELECT region,
       product_line,
       NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY STDDEV(sales) DESC) AS volatility_quartile,
       CORR(price, units) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS price_units_corr,
       AVG(sales) AS avg_sales
FROM monthly_sales
GROUP BY region, product_line;
